prompt: Objective: reduce defects at an electronics factory. What you've learned: defects rose from 1% to 4%. Latest finding: the increase is on night shifts only. What is the best next step?

options.text: Break defects down by product line
options.feedback: Less targeted: the defects are already isolated to night shifts.

options.text: Check whether suppliers changed parts recently
options.feedback: New parts would affect both shifts, but only nights got worse.

options.text: Compare the night and day shifts
options.feedback: Right. The problem is isolated to nights, so compare the shifts.

options.text: Work out what cancelling night shifts would save
options.feedback: That jumps to a drastic fix before finding the cause.

explanation: Defects rose only on night shifts, so compare what differs between shifts.
